stay.price_basis: Mid: Booking.com hotel pages for Tala (the Bandhavgarh gate village) with check-in Wed 18 Nov 2026, check-out Thu 19 Nov 2026, 2 adults 1 room, cheapest room rate WITHOUT meals, TAX-INCLUSIVE ('Includes taxes and charges', Booking does not show a pre-tax figure): Royal Jungle Kothi Deluxe Double 3,780 (breakfast optional Rs 300), Maharaja Kothi by Alivaa Standard Queen 4,696, Grand Narmada Jungle Homestay Resort Deluxe Quadruple 4,988 (breakfast optional Rs 250), Tiger Heaven Resort Deluxe Suite 16,815; median of 4 = (4,696+4,988)/2. stay.notes: Most Bandhavgarh lodges only sell meal-inclusive rates, so room-only n is small. Excluded: MPT White Tiger Forest Lodge (MP Tourism prints INR 3090-4990 with no meal plan; EaseMyTrip shows breakfast+lunch+dinner at 4,990 and 6,190), Tiger Trails and Wildlife Retreat (price shown is a sign-in members-only price), Spree Maati / Lazymojo / Olive (only breakfast-included rates), Atulya Kanchi, Aranyak, Bandhavgarh Jungle Lodge, Monsoon Forest, Tree of Life, Oberoi (all-inclusive or dinner included), Jungle Palace Resort (Umaria) and Citrus Prime (Parasi), which are not in Tala.
